versions.subject: feat: multiple fixes and updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' use '
        - ' http'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") CommandLine IN ("* use *", "* http*")
